senses.gloss: f. (טָבַע II) impression; ט׳ עַיִן identification of an object from a general impression of its form without stating particular marks.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 114a:7">Sabb. 114ᵃ</cite> <he>שמחזירין … בט׳ העין</he> to whom a lost object is restored on his identification etc. [Some ed. <he>טְבִיעַת</he>.]
